title: Light Outplays L With A Fake Rule: Part 2

series.summary: The task force discovers the fake thirteen-day rule and clears Light and Misa of suspicion, allowing Light to have his handcuffs removed before sending Misa to unearth the hidden Death Note and trade half her lifespan to Ryuk for Shinigami eyes.

cuts.voiceover_text: A single rule inside the murder notebook suddenly turns every detective completely upside down. The task force reads the instructions written on the back cover of the seized death note. According to the text, anyone who fails to write names consecutively within thirteen days will instantly die. The detectives freeze in stunned realization. Light Yagami and Misa Amane were held under constant surveillance in solitary confinement for over fifty days while executions never stopped. If this rule is genuine, neither of them could possibly be Kira. Relief washes over the room as the investigators celebrate their absolute innocence.

With suspicion shattered, the heavy steel handcuffs linking Light to the lead detective are finally removed. Light maintains a calm, humble expression, politely asking to continue assisting the investigation as a trusted ally. L reluctantly accepts his cooperation. Beneath his composed demeanor, Light is entirely triumphant. His masterfully fabricated thirteen-day rule completely neutralized the detective’s keen intuition. L has no choice but to accept supernatural rules written by a Shinigami. Light silently gloats in the shadows, knowing his greatest rival has been hopelessly outmaneuvered. Defying the self-proclaimed god of the new world carries only one sentence, and execution draws near.

Acting on secret directions whispered by Light, Misa ventures into the secluded woods and unearths the buried notebook. Touching the dark leather instantly restores all her dormant memories as Kira’s second disciple. She opens Light’s handwritten letter with trembling anticipation. His direct instructions are chillingly clear: she must write L’s real name into the Death Note to eliminate him permanently. She is ordered to tear out individual pages, rebury the notebook, and burn the incriminating letter. Light promises his lifelong devotion if she succeeds. Misa is overjoyed by his words, eager to destroy the greatest obstacle standing in their way.

Back in her private quarters, panic takes hold when Misa realizes she cannot remember the name of Light’s target. Ryuk looms over her with an ominous proposition. The Shinigami warns that trading for his supernatural eyes will slice her remaining lifespan in half for a second time. Unshaken by the deadly cost, Misa agrees without hesitation, determined to deliver the fatal blow for the man she loves.
